programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Moving Target : When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Cruel Revenge : A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The World Trade Center Bombing : Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Family Secrets : A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Hunter's Target : Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Secrets : Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: First and Kennedy Street Crew : In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Killing Zone : In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Killer Instinct : In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Predator : An Arizona girl's 1984 kidnapping leads the FBI on the trail of a key suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Voice of Terror : In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dixie Mafia : On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Above the Law : California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Final Takedown : The United States is one of the most profitable drug markets in the world. For ruthless and sophisticated drug traffickers, it is truly the land of opportunity.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Lost Boys : In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Lawless : A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Blood Brothers : When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Electronic Witness : George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: True Crime : They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Traces Of Guilt : Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence  a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Compulsion : Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker  the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Random Targets : Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Missing : Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Undaunted : Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, Investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Blood Money : Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Loved To Death : A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Tools Of Death : Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Presumed Dead : What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lasting Impressions : No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Death Grip : Fingerprinting: The identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Impressions : 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Proof Of Innocence : DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: False Witness : When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Misplaced Loyalty : In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Shape Searchers : Joe and Blue are playing Shape Searchers and they need our help. Blue pulls various shapes out of her bag and we look around and find things with the same shape!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Surprise Guest : It's time to clean up because a special guest is coming over to visit! But who is it? We play Blue's Clues to figure out who our surprise guest is. While searching for clues, we straighten up the house.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Contraptions : We're making contraptions! Joe demonstrates his amazing "Crayon Slide" for us. Blue is making a contraption, too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it's going to do.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: A Brand New Game : Everyone is making up games today! Joe's made-up game is called Presto Change-Joe! Joe changes something about his appearance and we try to figure out what's different.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Big Band : Who's got rhythm? We all do! All of our friends are making music! What instrument is Blue going to play in Blue's Big Band?

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Joe's Surprise Party : Shh! It's Joe's birthday and everyone's planning a surprise party! The characters in the house need our help to get things ready - but something is missing. Let's play Blue's Clues to figure out what else we need to do.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Alphabet Train : All aboard! Everyone's in the backyard building an Alphabet Train. The train is made up of lots of boxes-one for each letter- and we need to help find something for each box. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what will work.

programme.title: Blue's Clues

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Numbers Everywhere! : Today we're counting things throughout the house and labeling them with big numbers. We learn that Joe's favorite number is one. But what's Blue's favorite? We play Blue's Clues to figure out which number is Blue's favorite!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Up Down, All Around : Where is Baby Bird? Over or under Joe's head? On or off the branch? Using relational concepts, we help Joe find Baby Bird. Blue wants to find something too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Bedtime Business : Wow, you're over pretty late today. Joe's stuffed duck Boris is ready for his favorite part of bedtime, getting tucked in, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue's favorite part of bedtime is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Prediction : What's going to happen next? Some big event seems to be brewing on the patio, but we're not sure what. Blue has an idea, though, so we play Blue's Clues to predict what's going to happen on the patio.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Dress Up Day : Everybody is dressing up today! Blue is being a giraffe, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants us to be! Joe tries different costumes throughout the day - does he want to be an explorer, robot, or a duck?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: The Story Wall : We're making a giant story on the wall with pictures! It's about some rabbits who go on a trip to visit their grandma. But what will the rabbits do once they get to her house? Blue knows! We play Blue's Clues to figure it out!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Magenta's Messages : Magenta is going on a trip and asked us to take care of her house while she's away! Magenta leaves us a message so we'll know what to do. Blue wants to write a message, too and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what to say.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Let's Write! : Joe and Blue are being writers today! We're making labels for things in our house - like-hat, door, and Sidetable Drawer. Using our finger, we help Joe write letters. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to write.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Combat : Wendy s'attire des ennuis en menaçant Cartman de le frapper après l'école. Peu importe la rage de Wendy, tous les paris donnent Cartman gagnant.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: À propos d'hier soir : Barack Obama vient de remporter les élections présidentielles face à McCain. Tout le pays est divisé entre les gagnants, dont Randy, qui font la fête ; et les perdants, dont Ike, qui sont persuadés que la fin du monde est proche.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Elementary School Musical : Les garçons se rendent compte qu'ils ne sont plus les plus cools de l'école. Stan réalise qu'il pourrait perdre Wendy s'il ne change rien à cette situation !

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Impunissable : Les enfants Goth de l'école élémentaire de South Park ont de la concurrence. Butters est persuadé d'avoir vu un vampire à l'école, mais personne ne l'écoute.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Bague : Kenny emmène sa petite amie à un concert des Jonas Brothers, pensant que celui-ci le mènera à son cœur et à d'autres parties du corps.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon : Persuadé que la ville de South Park a besoin d'un super-héros, Cartman devient, la nuit venue, Le Coon.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Margaritaville : Randy annonce qu'il a une solution pour sortir le pays de son désastre économique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mange, prie et froute : Les enfants sont surexcités car en rentrant chez eux ils verront la suite d'un épisode de Terrence et Phillip.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Derby de Pinewood : Stan participe avec son père Randy à une course de petites voitures en bois, le Derby de Pinewood.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Barbobèse : Butters et un petit groupe de recrues rejoignent Cartman dans son rêve de vivre sur l'île du crâne où se trouve un trésor enterré.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Vedettes mortes : Des fantômes de célébrités récemment décédées tourmentent Ike. Il est mort de peur et le stress pourrait bien le tuer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Meilleure Gagneuse de Butters : Butters découvre une activité lucrative après avoir pour la première fois fait payer un baiser. Mais le sergent Yates décide de lutter très activement contre la prostitution.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Catch : Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent leur nouvelle passion dans la vie après être allés à un combat de catch et se dépêchent de signer pour le club de lutte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Putain de baleines : Stan fête son anniversaire avec sa famille à l'aquarium de Denver où ils vont pouvoir nager avec les dauphins.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fiottes : Les enfants vont se battre pour que le festival Harley ne ruine pas leur week-end à South Park !

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Danse avec les Schtroumpfs : Cartman prend le contrôle des annonces du matin à l'école. Grâce à cela, il veut devenir la voix du changement !

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pipi : Stan, Cartman, Kyle, Kenny, Butters et Jimmy se rendent au parc aquatique pour une journée pleine de fun. Malheureusement, les choses se passent autrement et ils ont rendez-vous avec la mort.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Guérison sexuelle : Tous les grands scientifiques des Etats-Unis se réunissent pour plancher sur une épidémie étrange: l'addiction au sexe. Il semblerait que les hommes riches et puissants veulent soudainement coucher avec des tonnes de femmes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'histoire de Scrotie McMorvoburnes : Après avoir lu le livre controversé de J.D. Salinger, 'L'Attrape-cœurs' Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny se lancent à leur tour dans l'écriture d'un roman. Mais la mère de Stan découvre leur prose.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Medicinal Fried Chicken : Le restaurant préféré de Cartman a fermé et laissé place à une pharmacie qui vend du cannabis médicinal. Randy essaie alors désespérément d'obtenir une prescription médicale pour pouvoir s'en procurer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Vous avez 0 amis : Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent Facebook et les relations entre 'amis' virtuels. Malheureusement pour lui, Kyle accepte de devenir ami avec la mauvaise personne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Été handicapé : Cet été, l'heure n'est pas à la détente mais à la compétition. Jimmy et ses amis handicapés mettent tout en oeuvre pour être les champions du camp de vacances.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pauvre et stupide : Eric Cartman rêve de devenir pilote de Nascar et est prêt à tout pour y parvenir. Comme il est persuadé qu'il faut être pauvre et stupide pour exceller dans cette discipline, il va tenter de se débarrasser de tout son argent et de ses neurones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: C'est un truc new-jersien : Pour lutter contre l'invasion des habitants de New Jersey, la ville de South Park se mobilise et en vient à faire appel à Oussama Ben Laden.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Inception, m'voyez : À la demande de Wendy Testaburger, Stan accepte de ranger son casier avec l'aide d'un groupe de 'spécialistes'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Captain Konstadt : Le Coon et ses amis sont disposés à aider les victimes de la marée noire provoquée par BP suite à un accident de forage dans le Golfe du Mexique.

programme.desc: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch! : The battle for Block B hits a crescendo as King Elizabello II prepares his devastating King Punch! But as the powerful attack becomes imminent, the Prodence Kingdom faction unravels! All that may be pointless, though.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Fighting Fish Strike! Across the Deadly Iron Bridge! : As the handover team approaches Green Bit, they are attacked by the fearsome fish that live off the coast of Dressrosa. But that's the least of their problems as they find the bridge to Green Bit has collapsed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Explore! Fairies' Island - Green Bit! : Zoro tracks the thief who stole his sword - and learns about a danger facing the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Law, Usopp, and the others arrive at Green Bit only to find it inhabited by strange creatures, and swarming with the Navy soldiers!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom! : All but done for, Sanji is trapped by Violet and her crew when she suddenly changes her mind and mysteriously turns on her own men! Meanwhile, Robin and Usopp come face to face with the Little People known as the Tontatta Tribe.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Stratagem of the Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move! : Sanji gets in touch with Law in order to share a shocking secret - that could unsettle the Straw Hats' plans in Dressrosa for good! Meanwhile, Luffy's Block C battle begins, but will his Gum-Gum powers give him away?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shaking Heaven and Earth! Admiral Fujitora's Power! : Sanji and Franky try to regroup after Doflamingo's betrayal, hoping that destroying the factory is not yet out of their grasp. Meanwhile Luffy makes a friend in the Colosseum and Usopp ends up thrust into an uncomfortable position!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy! : The Sunny is mysteriously deformed by the bizarre powers of Giolla! Can Nami, Chopper, and Brook act in time to save their beloved home? Meanwhile, the battle for Block C continues as Luffy suffers a staggering setback.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy in Trouble! : After knocking down the Giant, Hajrudin, as payback for what he did to Ucy, Luffy has to deal with Ideo, whose punch has the destructive force of a bomb, while the Funk Brothers show off their bizarre fighting technique.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chin Jao! : Nami, Chopper, and Brooke keep trying to evade Jora and win back the Sunny even though it's been turned into a piece of art! In the Colosseum, Don Chin Jao finally faces Luffy - whose power will prove greater?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Light and Shadow! Darkness behind Dressrosa! : Luffy stands along against Don Chinjao, and learns about the old grudge he bears against Garp! Meanwhile, Usopp and Robin get swept up in the Tontatta Kingdom's raid against the royal family, and Franky learns the eerie secret of Dressrosa.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Making a Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland! : The Tontatta Kingdom gears up for its all-out assault on the Doflamingo Family, as Usopp and Robin are caught up in the war effort! Meanwhile, Franky arrives the headquarters of the toy movement where he finds Zoro, Nami & the others are cornered by Jora.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Fierce Battle Coming to the End! Lucy vs. Chin Jao! : Don Chin Jao's hatred of Garp and Luffy is finally explained, while his battle against Luffy comes to an end. With tremendous power, one of them is squarely eliminated! But is that really the end of the Colosseum battle?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Gladiator of Fate - Rebecca! : With the battle with Don Chinjao long behind him, Luffy advances to the final round! Block-D contender Cavendish, however, takes the chance and pounces on Luffy, who is defended by an unlikely ally! The agenda of Colosseum gladiator Rebecca is exposed.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Protect You to the End! Rebecca and the Toy Soldier! : Rebecca's deep bonds with the one-legged toy soldier are revealed! Her lineage can be traced to the previous ruler of Dressrosa - and her eternal bond with the damaged toy is linked to the violent overthrow of that regime by none other than Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Last - and Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins! : As Rebecca enters the ring for the battle for Block D, the crowd shows its contempt for her heritage - only to be scolded by an unlikely supporter. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats start to reassemble to deal with the attack on the Sunny.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. the Straw Hats! : Doflamingo recounts for Law the surprising history of the Don Quixote Family, while Nami and the others battle the insane and powerful artist, Giolla! Her ultimate attack renders them incapacitated, and prompts the betrayal of one of their closest allies!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish of the White Horse! : Law is pinned by Fujitora, and Doflamingo has the upper hand! Only the most cunning of tricks could save Law's plan to hand Caesar over to Nami & the others! Meanwhile, the Sunny falls into danger again, & the battle for Block D heats up in the Colosseum.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo! : Law must put himself in harm's way to defend the Sunny and the Straw Hats from Doflamingo's all-out assault! With barely enough time to save the crew, plans change and send the Sunny on a new mission -- but will it be able to get underway?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Rebecca's Special Attack! Last-Ditch Sword Dance! : Law & Doflamingo are embroiled in a heated showdown which triggers Momonosuke's memories of Doflamingo's cruelty from the first time they met; meanwhile, after a tearful fanboy conversation Zoro finally gets to see Luffy but all eyes are fixed on Rebecca.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game : Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next? : What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue : Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Crab : Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper the Explorer : Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Jack-in-the-Box : Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bark, Bark to Play Park : It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves Three Kings Day : "Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents, and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Isa's Unicorn Flowers : Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a Rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny's Big Race : Benny is so excited – it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-carts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: First Day of School : Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Backpack Parade : Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited 'cause this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bouncy Boots : "Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the Shoe Shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots -- these are bouncy boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Mayan Adventure : Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ballplayers. A long time ago in a Mayan Kingdom, there was a big Ball Game Championship.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies : Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the Piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show : ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny's Treasure : It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Super Babies' Dream Adventure : It's naptime for the twins and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Pirate Treasure Hunt : Pirate Piggy really wants to be in the big Pirate Treasure Hunt, but his Piggies got tummyaches. He needs at least 3 mates to help him find the sunken treasure. Dora, Boots, and L'il Piggy will be his pirate mates -- yay!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Helps the Birthday Wizzle : Dora reads a story about a Wizzle who could grant wishes with his magic wand. On his birthday, it's his turn to make a wish but the wand gets blown away by the wind. Dora needs your help to save the Wizzle's magic wand!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Banana Wish : Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas falls down on Boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Pegaso Adventure : Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the Moon before the Sun rises!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Birthday, Super Babies! : Happy Birthday, Super Babies!: It's the Twins' 1st birthday and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a Cake-snatching Bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Hair-Raising Adventure : Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Winky Comes Home : Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married : The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his Grandma's House! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Vacaciones! : Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand : The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land where it breaks!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora in Troll Land : Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge. When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Dance Show : Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' First Bike : Dora and Boots are heading to the Bike Shop to pick up Boots' very first bike today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Pepe's School Day Adventure : Dora's helping her new friend, Pepe the Pig, learn all about his new school. Pepe's really excited, especially when he hears that if the class earns 3 gold stars today, they get a popcorn party!

programme.desc: Desk Wars/Desperately Seeking Stanley : When Mr. Ratburn moves Brain and Arthur away from their usual desks, it sets off a chain reaction resulting in the most explosive desk war in third grade history! And, Arthur is 8-years old now—does he still need his teddy bear?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy's Art Attack/Tales from the Crib : When Muffy sees a kinetic sculptor’s machines, she brags that she can make even better ones. Then, Vicita is upset at having to trade in her cherished crib for a big-girl bed, so D.W. shares her story of that same rite of passage.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Do You Speak George?/World Girls : Everyone at school is speaking their own made-up language, and George can't make sense of what anyone is saying. And it's the grand opening of World Girl World, which sells dolls from every country, and every girl in town is thrilled!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What's Cooking?/Buster's Special Delivery : Celebrity chef Ming Tsai is judging Lakewood Elementary's first-ever cooking contest, and Arthur thinks he has a shot at winning. Then, Buster volunteers to deliver the school mail and finds out that his new job is actually hard work!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Swept Away/Germophobia : Arthur, D.W. and Buster are spending a few days at the beach. Can they save their sandcastle from the ocean tides? Buster's friends have had enough of his sloppy habits, so they band together to educate him on the realities of bacteria.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Sells Out/Mind Your Manners : To earn the money for a new video game, Arthur decides to sell his old toys through his school's Web site. The Tibble Twins want to take Grandmother out to dinner, but she'd rather stay home. Is it because of their terrible table manners?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buenas Noches, Vicita/Prunella Packs It In : Vicita Molina has lost her favorite bedtime book – can Arthur help her re-create it? Prunella is already starting to think about college! Will she crack under the heavy load or will she learn to relax and do the things she actually enjoys?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Phony Fern/Brain's Shocking Secret : When Fern's parents give her a cell phone for emergencies, she soon becomes hooked on it. Brain is the smartest kid in class. Everyone knows that! What they don't know is that he was kept back in Kindergarten. Will Binky spill the beans?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Baby Kate and the Imaginary Mystery/Strangers on a Train : Nadine, D.W.'s imaginary friend is missing. Sue Ellen can't wait to travel on an old-fashioned train, but once onboard, she discovers that the train is not as spectacular as she had hoped–until she finds a mysterious diary.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Making of Arthur/Dancing Fools : When Matt Damon puts out a call for homemade videos for his TV show, he sets off a frantic rush as Arthur and his gang film their lives. Mrs. Molina is a teaching a dance class for kids. Will Francine and George be the next Fred and Ginger?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Hic or Treat/Mr. Alwaysright : D.W. gets a case of the hiccups that just won't go away. Will she have them for the rest of her life and set the world record? It seems that Brain is always right about everything and it's really starting to get on Buster's nerves.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine's Pilfered Paper/Buster Gets Real : When Francine has a big paper over Thanksgiving, she copies from a website. There's nothing wrong with that, is there? Everyone loves the new Top Supermarket reality series on TV, except Arthur. Will it end his friendship with Buster?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. on Ice/Spoiled Rotten! : D.W. tells her friends that she's a fantastic skater, but she can barely stand on ice! With a skating party coming up, how will she face everyone and tell them the truth? Accused of being spoiled, Muffy sets out to prove her friends wrong.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Big Brother Binky, Parts I&II : Binky's family has decided to adopt a little girl from China. The thought of a baby sister makes Binky happy, until he realized there are some changes in store. It’s a lot harder than he thought, but it has its rewards too.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is That Kosher/Never Never Never : Francine's convinced that she can fast on Yom Kippur, but what about Arthur’s pizza party? D.W learns that giving gifts isn't the only way of showing you care. Featuring the voice of Joan Rivers.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Room to Ride/The Frensky Family Fiasco : With Lance Armstrong’s support, Binky and his friends take to the streets to convince residents to vote for new bike safety lanes. Francine wants the Frenskys to be closer, but a weekly Family Night turns out to be harder than expected.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'S Stray Netkitin/Bats in the Belfry : D.W. is panicked when a virus ruins the Read family computer. Who will take care of her virtual pet? Arthur and D.W. are thrilled when Grandma Thora lets them turn her attic into a clubhouse. But will a bat threaten their new play space?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: For the Birds/Ungifted : Brain dreams of being the first to spot a rare bird species called the green-tailed grebe, making him famous. Arthur and Buster's friendship is put to the test when Arthur gives away a present that Buster had given him for his birthday.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Chronicles of Buster/On this Spot : Buster learns that special effects can't take the place of hard work when conquering real mountains. Arthur is thrilled to find out that Sitting Bull once passed through town! He rallies the residents to mark the spot with a monument.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Cherry Tree/Matchmaker Matchbreaker : Muffy wants a Bouncy Castle at her party, but when her favorite cherry tree is cut down to make room for it, she starts to have regrets. Francine and Muffy scheme to set up their older siblings Chip and Catherine, but plans go awry.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: War of the Worms/I Owe You One : Brain is always taking the fun out of Fern's storytelling by correcting her facts, but things gets out of hand when Fern tricks him with a fake story! Buster is always asking for favors. Will he learn the real meaning of friendship?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Blackout/Mei Lin Takes a Stand : It's a hot day in Elwood City, and a total blackout leaves its residents without electricity! Will Arthur and DW survive without AC and TV? Binky's baby sister Mei-Lin isn't keen on learning to walk and would rather stick to crawling.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Home Sweet Home/Do You Believe in Magic : It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Perfect Game/D.W.'s Furry Freakout : Francine is excited about a school project, but she's so obsessed with making it perfect that she can't seem to get anything done at all. When D.W. finds a stray kitten, it soon turns out to be a lot more than D.W. can handle.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: No Acting, Please/Prunella and the Disappointing Ending : Fern lands a role in a community theatre production but fears she is not talented enough to be a star actress; Prunella and Marina compete to read a book.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Number Nightmare/Brain Gets Hooked : When Arthur and friends discover what looks like a list of their class rankings in Principal Haney's office, they are all taken for a surprise.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: MacFrensky/The Good, the Bad, and the Binky : When Francine and Brain are locked in a stiff competition to win student of the month, Muffy talks Francine into "borrowing" Buster's toy and letting Brain take the blame for it.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Russia : Welcome to Putin’s Russia. If you don’t fall into line, you could be the target of a show trial and be thrown into a penal colony. But if you’re hungry you might actually find something worth eating.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Shanghai : Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Budapest : For the first time, Tony visits Budapest, 25 years after democracy planted its flag –alongside the Oscar-winning master of light, cinematographer Vilmos Zsigmond, as one of his key guides.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Hawaii : Tony explores the other Hawaii, the one that those eight million tourists don’t see when they come to the islands. He discovers the fabric of a true cultural mixing pot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Salvador, Brazil : Tony heads back to his much-beloved Salvador, Brazil. The ever-present street festivals and the famous Carnival parade begin with sitting down with a local artist in the streets of the historic Pelo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Massachusetts : This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Congo : Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Las Vegas : Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Mexico City : Tony travels to Mexico City and Oaxaca to meet who fight for the food, the art, and the lives they believe in. In the Santa Anita neighbourhood of Mexico City, Tony meets boxer Jorge Lacierva.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: New Mexico : New Mexico has the largest Hispanic population per capita in the US. No better way to see the mash-up of cultures that make up this uniquely American State, than by what the people here are eating

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: New Jersey : In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony travels back to his homeland, his roots, his favorite state in the union: New Jersey. Part nostalgia, part cautionary tale. Tony makes sure to hit up some NJ classics.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Shanghai : Anthony Bourdain explores the vibrant, dynamic city of Shanghai.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Colombia : Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tokyo : Tony travels to Tokyo in search of the city's dark, extreme underside.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Copenhagen : Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Madagascar : In this episode of Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown, Tony travels to Madagascar, a place that outsiders understand surprisingly little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Mississippi Delta : Tony seeks to challenge his notions of Mississippi by taking a road trip to meet a cast of Mississippians enjoying the diverse foodways and embracing the traditional and contemporary music worlds.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Miami : In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony explores a few of the many faces of Miami. Chef Michelle Bernstein takes Tony out to an authentic Cuban breakfast and a late-night dinner at a gas station café in Doral.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit : Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tangier : Tony explores what Burroughs called "Interzone," where artists sought escape from Western moral prohibitions and the possibilities of great empty spaces. But what is it like now?
